name: Apartments Stubai
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Apartments Stubai are holiday apartments located in the Stubaital Valley in Tyrol. Each apartment features a fully equipped kitchen and its own bathroom. The apartments accommodate two to five people. A ski storage room and free parking spaces are available. The accommodation is conveniently situated near the Stubaier Gletscher and numerous hiking trails. The area is perfect for skiing and snowboarding. Even in summer, the apartments serve as an excellent starting point for excursions.
